name: critic P14/P19 a2r1 (fresh) — a child mashing Enter through the real demo, carried fight to fight

steps.eval: (window.tap = (code = 'Enter') => { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {code, key: code, bubbles: true})); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {code, key: code, bubbles: true})); }, window.mash = async (cond, max = 800, d = 200) => { for (let i = 0; i < max; i++) { try { if (cond()) return i; } catch (e) {} window.tap(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, d)); } return -1; }, window.R = {}, 'ok')

steps.note: A. The very first fight: Long Lane, Lv 1, Papa and Bobble. Enter only.

steps.eval: JSON.stringify({r: __DQ.state().battle.turn, res: (({outcome,exp,gold}) => ({outcome,exp,gold}))(__DQ.state().snapshot.result), party: __DQ.state().party.map(p => p.name + ' ' + p.hp + '/' + p.mhp + ' Lv' + p.lvl)})

steps.note: B. Keep mashing (Enter on the end menu = Another fight) until the first level-up.
C. Rhythm: eight more mashed fights on the Long Lane, recording rounds / EXP / HP.

steps.eval: (async () => { const out = []; for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) { const f0 = __DQ.state().carried.fights; await mash(() => __DQ.state().carried.fights > f0, 500, 150); const s = __DQ.state(); const r = s.snapshot.result || {}; out.push([s.carried.fights, r.outcome, 'r' + r.rounds, 'exp' + r.exp, 'Lv' + s.carried.levels.hero, s.party.map(p => p.hp + '/' + p.mhp).join(',')].join(' ')); } return out.join(' || '); })()

steps.note: D. Whispering Wood, the children alone: watch Willow's Scorcha and Sera's Mend (Fight! auto).

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const s = __DQ.state(); if (['victory','defeat','fled'].includes(s.battle.phase)) break; if (__DQ.log(60).some(l => /Scorcha|Mend/.test(l)) && !__DQ.idle()) return 'spell ' + i; if (__DQ.idle() && s.ui.menu && s.ui.menu.kind === 'command') tap('KeyF'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120)); } return 'none'; })()

steps.note: E. Mumbleroot at the level children arrive (7), carried from the Wood party, mashing Enter.

steps.eval: (() => { __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.battle('cobwell_manor', {boss: true, level: 7, seed: 777}); return JSON.stringify(__DQ.state().snapshot.enemies.map(e => e.name + ' ' + e.hp)); })()
JSON.stringify({round: __DQ.state().battle.turn, phase: __DQ.state().battle.phase, party: __DQ.state().party.map(p => p.name + ' ' + p.hp + '/' + p.mhp), log: __DQ.log(10)})

steps.note: F. Act II Pelican Coast, Lv 12: mash until a monster asks to join; answer Yes with Enter.

steps.eval: mash(() => { const m = __DQ.state().ui.menu; return m && m.kind === 'recruit'; }, 3000, 140)

steps.note: G. A gentle defeat: Bram alone at Lv1 vs two Bumbleblunders, mashing.

steps.eval: (() => { for (let s = 1; s < 300; s++) { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.battle('long_lane_alone', {level: 1, enemies: [{id: 'bumbleblunder', partyLevel: 4}, {id: 'bumbleblunder', partyLevel: 4}], seed: s}); __DQ.autoplay(99, 'mash'); if (__DQ.state().battle.phase === 'defeat') { __DQ.instant(false); window.R.defeatSeed = s; return s; } } __DQ.instant(false); return -1; })()
(() => { __DQ.battle('long_lane_alone', {level: 1, enemies: [{id: 'bumbleblunder', partyLevel: 4}, {id: 'bumbleblunder', partyLevel: 4}], seed: window.R.defeatSeed}); return 'ok'; })()
